strategies.name: Swing momentum
strategies.rule: Trade in the direction of a 1-hour move of at least $0.10; enter at the quoted ask/bid, exit at +$0.10, -$0.10, or resolution.

strategies.name: Fade the swing
strategies.rule: Trade against a 1-hour move of at least $0.10 (mean reversion); same exits as S1.

strategies.name: Model edge
strategies.rule: Take the side with the largest modelled edge (p_hat vs quoted ask/bid) when the edge is at least $0.03 per contract; same exits.
